purpose: Assemble an evidence-backed, date-aware narrative of the legal life of a property from approved chronology, interests, parties, relationships, events, state changes and legal effects.
core_principle: PROPERTY LIFE = CHRONOLOGY + INTERESTS + PARTIES + EVENTS + STATE CHANGES + LAW + EVIDENCE
rules: Narrative prose may only state propositions established by the approved underlying components.
Chronology is not itself proof of causation.
A relationship is not an ownership conclusion unless the underlying interest and evidence establish it.
Legal effect must retain its applicable temporal version and conditions.
Related events may be grouped for readability but their distinct dates and legal effects remain recoverable.
Current state must not overwrite historical state.
Missing evidence must be expressed as a limitation rather than silently filled.
Every material narrative statement must remain traceable to supporting evidence and legal sources.
hard_stops: Never invent continuity between historical events.
Never turn a graph relationship into a legal fact without supporting evidence.
Never state causation when only chronology is established.
Never omit a material limitation for narrative smoothness.
Never expose restricted/private evidence in the public narrative.
Never replace historical law with current law without temporal verification.
